title: Black Death Reaches Europe
description:
The **Black Death**, one of the most devastating pandemics in human history, arrived in Europe in 1347 through merchant ships from the Black Sea. The plague would kill an estimated 75-200 million people.

The disease, caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, spread rapidly across Europe, killing between 30-60% of the population. It arrived at the port of Messina, Sicily, in October 1347.

The Black Death had profound economic, social, and cultural impacts, fundamentally changing the course of European history.
